items.exampleEn: In "I want to swim," "to swim" is an infinitive.
items.exampleZh: 在「I want to swim」裡，「to swim」是不定詞。

items.exampleEn: Learning antonyms helps you remember new words.
items.exampleZh: 學反義詞能幫助你記住新單字。

items.exampleEn: "The" is the only definite article in English.

items.sentenceEn: Use the definite article before "sun" and "moon."
items.sentenceZh: 在 sun 和 moon 前面要用定冠詞。

items.audioEn: Today we'll learn about prepositions, like "in," "on," and "under."
items.audioZh: 今天我們要學介系詞，像是 in、on 和 under。

items.sentenceEn: An adverb can describe a verb.
My teacher wrote ten antonyms on the board.
items.sentenceZh: 老師在黑板上寫了十組反義詞。

items.stemEn: "Big" and "small" are ____ because they have opposite meanings.
A word that tells us how something is done, like "carefully," is an ____.
items.stemZh: 像 carefully 這種說明事情怎麼做的字，是副詞。

items.passageEn: Our English teacher made a grammar game. Each team had to find different kinds of words in a short story. My team found ten adverbs and eight prepositions. Then we had to find every infinitive, like "to run" and "to eat." The hardest part was the past participles, such as "written" and "broken." Our teacher also asked us to use the definite article correctly and to give an antonym for each adjective. Finally, we wrote one adverbial phrase, like "very slowly." Some parts were confusing, but it was fun, and my team won!
items.passageZh: 我們的英文老師設計了一個文法遊戲。每一隊都要在一篇短文裡找出不同種類的字。我們這隊找到了十個副詞和八個介系詞。接著，我們要找出每個不定詞，像是「to run」和「to eat」。最難的部分是過去分詞，例如「written」和「broken」。老師還要我們正確使用定冠詞，並為每個形容詞寫出反義詞。最後，我們寫了一個副詞片語，例如「very slowly」。有些部分很令人困惑，但很好玩，而且我們這隊贏了！

questions.questionZh: 遊戲中最難的部分是什麼？
options: 為每個名詞寫一個例句
把整篇短文翻譯成中文

questions.questionZh: 最後一個步驟要做什麼？
options: 把所有答案大聲唸給全班聽
和另一隊交換短文互相檢查
